exposure: Type of hysterotomy (standard stapled hysterotomy vs. sutured mini-hysterotomy <=3.5 cm) during prenatal spina bifida repair
outcome: Reversal of hindbrain herniation within 1 week after surgery
cohort: Consecutive women undergoing prenatal repair for spina bifida aperta via either stapled hysterotomy or sutured mini-hysterotomy.
finding: Prenatal spina bifida repair through mini-hysterotomy was associated with a significantly lower risk of preterm delivery (<37 weeks and <34+6 weeks) compared to standard hysterotomy, with comparable rates of intact uterine scar, hindbrain herniation reversal, and cerebrospinal fluid leakage.
mod_finding: Mini-hysterotomy resulted in a later gestational age at delivery and a comparable intact uterine scar rate, both of which are critical factors influencing the timing and safety of birth.
followup_time: Up to 1 week after prenatal surgery and at the time of delivery.
